blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remote sensing change detection usually relies on large collections of temporally aligned, pixel-level annotations, which limits its scalability across regions, imaging platforms and application domains. Recent zero-shot approaches reduce the need for supervision, but they often localize fine-grained changes poorly because their features are coarse or inconsistent across time. We present SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for zero-shot change detection built by composing complementary vision foundation models. SpotDiff uses DINOv3 for semantically robust features, AnyUp to reconstruct them at pixel resolution, and SAM 3 for text-guided region-of-interest proposals, which an inference-time multi-scale strategy (SWIMS) makes reliable on small objects. Change is then measured by comparing the reconstructed features of the two dates inside the proposed regions, with no learnable components, fine-tuning or change labels. To our knowledge, SpotDiff is the first change detection method to use a universal feature upsampler, which alone adds 13.8 F1 over bilinear upsampling of the same features. On LEVIR-CD, SpotDiff reaches 82.46 F1, 2.06 points above the strongest prior training-free method, and on the multi-class SECOND benchmark it improves building change detection by 10.3 IoU and the six-class average by 2.2 IoU. Qualitative results on PlanetScope (3 m) and Sentinel-2 (10 m) imagery show that the same pipeline transfers across resolutions without modification. Our results indicate that composing modern foundation models is an effective route to scalable, label-free change detection.
blocks.zh: 遥感变化探测通常依赖于大量时间对齐,像素级说明的集合,这限制了其跨区域,成像平台和应用域的伸缩性. 近期的零射法减少了监督的必要性,但是它们往往将精细的磨损变化本地化,因为其特征粗糙,或者在一段时间内不一致. 我们介绍SpotDiff,一个无训练的,插件和游戏的零镜头变化检测框架,通过构建互补的视觉基础模型而构建. SpotDiff使用DINOv3来进行凝聚性强的特性,AnyUp在像素分辨率下重建它们,SAM 3则用于文本引导的利益区域建议,一个推论-时间多尺度策略(SWIMS)使得小对象上可靠. 然后通过比较拟议区域内两个日期的重建特征来衡量变化,没有可学习的组件,微调或更改标签. 据我们所知,SpotDiff是第一种使用通用特征提升标本的变换检测方法,仅此一项就比同一特征的双线提升标本增加了13.8 F1. 在LEVIR-CD上,SpotDiff比以往最强的无训练方法高82.46 F1,2.06分,在多级二等基准上,它改进了10.3IoU的建筑变化探测,6级平均值为2.2IoU. PlanetScope(3米)和Sentinel-2(10米)图像的质量结果显示,同一管道在分辨率之间不作修改转移。 我们的结果显示,构建现代基础模型是可扩展,无标签变化检测的有效途径.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Change detection, the task of identifying meaningful differences between images of the same area acquired at different times, underpins urban expansion monitoring, disaster assessment, infrastructure development, environmental monitoring and precision agriculture [ 6 , 10 ] .
Most state-of-the-art methods are trained on large collections of temporally aligned, pixel-level annotations [ 6 , 17 , 1 ] .
Such annotations are expensive to produce and rarely available across regions, imaging platforms and application domains, and supervised models often generalize poorly outside the distribution they were trained on.
blocks.zh:
变化探测,即查明在不同时期获得的同一地区图像之间有意义的差异的任务,是城市扩张监测、灾害评估、基础设施发展、环境监测和精准农业[6、10]的基础。
大部分最先进的方法都接受了时间对齐,像素级说明的大型集合[6,17,1]的培训.
这种说明很昂贵,而且很少跨区域、成像平台和应用领域提供,而且受监督的模型往往在它们所接受的培训的分布之外普遍使用。

blocks.en:
Vision foundation models have changed this picture.
Self-supervised vision transformers such as DINOv3 [ 29 ] learn semantically rich, transferable representations, and segmentation foundation models [ 22 , 26 , 3 ] localize objects zero-shot.
This raises a direct question for Earth observation: Can modern vision foundation models already perform accurate zero-shot change detection in remote sensing, without any task-specific training?
blocks.zh:
远景基础模型改变了这个画面.
DINOv3[29]等自控视变器学习精致丰富,可转移的表示,分块基模型[22],26,3]将物体定位为零射.
这对地球观测提出了直接问题: 现代视野基础模型能否在没有具体任务培训的情况下,在遥感中进行精确的零射变化探测?

blocks.en:
The answer is not obvious.
Foundation models are not designed for bi-temporal analysis.
Vision transformer features are produced at patch resolution (one vector per 16 × \times 16 pixels for DINOv3), too coarse to delineate small structures such as buildings.
Semantic similarity alone produces noisy change maps, because illumination, season and acquisition geometry also change between dates.
And nothing in these models restricts the analysis to the objects a user cares about.
blocks.zh:
答案并不明显。
基础模型不是为双时分析设计的.
透视变压器的特性以补丁分辨率产生(DINOv3的16xx\time16像素的1矢量),过于粗糙,无法划定建筑物等小结构.
语义上的相似性单是产生吵闹的变换图,因为发光,季节和获取几何学在日期之间也有所变化.
这些模型中没有任何东西限制分析对象为用户所关心的对象.

blocks.en:
We present SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that answers this question by composition ( Fig. 1 ).
SpotDiff combines DINOv3 for semantic features, AnyUp [ 33 ] to reconstruct them at pixel resolution, and SAM 3 [ 3 ] to propose regions of the queried category from a text prompt.
To make SAM 3 reliable on small objects in large tiles, we introduce SWIMS (sliding-window inference with multiple scales), which fuses proposals from several input scales.
Change is declared where the reconstructed features of the two dates disagree inside the proposed regions.
The framework has no learnable components, needs no temporal supervision, and lets each component be replaced as stronger models appear.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍SpotDiff,这是一个无培训、插件和游戏框架,通过组成来回答这个问题(图1)。
SpotDiff将 DINov3 组合为语义特性, AnyUp [33] 在像素分辨率下重建它们, SAM 3 [3] 从文本提示中提出被询问类别区域.
为了使SAM 3在大块小物体上可靠,我们引入了SWIMS(滑窗推论与多个尺度),它从几个输入尺度上将各种提案连接起来。
如果两个日期的重建特点在拟议区域内有分歧,则宣布作出改变。
框架没有可学习的组成部分,不需要时间监督,让每个组成部分随着更强大的模型的出现而被替换.

blocks.en:
The key observation behind SpotDiff is that modern self-supervised features are stable enough across acquisition dates that, once restored to pixel resolution and restricted to semantic region priors, plain cosine similarity localizes meaningful change.
In other words, strong zero-shot change detection can emerge from a careful composition of existing models, without a dedicated change detection architecture.
blocks.zh:
SpotDiff背后的关键观察是,现代自我监督的特征在整个获取日期都足够稳定,一旦恢复到像素分辨率,并仅限于语义区前身,平坦的同位素相似性就将有意义的变化本地化.
换句话说,强烈的零镜头变化检测可以从现有模型的仔细组成中出现,没有专门的变化检测架构.

blocks.en:
We evaluate SpotDiff on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, S2Looking and the multi-class SECOND benchmark, and show qualitative results on PlanetScope (3 m) and Sentinel-2 (10 m) imagery.
Among training-free methods published before April 2026, SpotDiff sets a new state of the art on LEVIR-CD (82.46 F1), WHU-CD and S2Looking, and on building change and the class average of SECOND.
blocks.zh:
我们在LEVIR-CD,WHU-CD,S2Looking和多级第二基准上评价SpotDiff,并在PlanetScope(3米)和Sentinel-2(10米)图像上显示质量结果.
在2026年4月前公布的无培训方法中,SpotDiff在LEVR-CD(82.46 F1),WHU-CD和S2Looking,以及建筑改变和二级平均班级上设定了新的艺术状态.

blocks.en: Contributions. • We present SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for zero-shot remote sensing change detection that composes a self-supervised encoder, a universal feature upsampler and a promptable segmentation model. To our knowledge, it is the first change detection method to use a universal feature upsampler, and we show that pixel-resolution features are the single most important ingredient after multi-scale proposals. • We show that comparing pixel-resolution self-supervised features inside text-guided region priors localizes change accurately without task-specific optimization, and we introduce SWIMS, a multi-scale inference strategy that makes the region priors reliable for small objects. • We evaluate SpotDiff on four public benchmarks and two additional sensors, with ablations of the upsampler, SWIMS, the similarity threshold and the text prompt, establishing a strong training-free baseline.
blocks.zh: • 捐款 我们介绍SpotDiff,一个零镜头遥感变化探测的无培训、插件和播放框架,它构成一个自我监督的编码器,一个通用的特征上标和快速分解模型。 据我们所知,这是第一个使用通用特性升标器的变异检测方法,我们显示,像素分辨率特性是多尺度建议后最重要的单一成分。 我们显示,比较文本制导区域内部的像素分辨率自我监督的特性,在不针对特定任务进行优化的情况下准确地本地化变化,我们引入了SWIMS,这是一种多尺度的推论策略,使区域对小对象的前置可靠. ^ 我们用四个公共基准和两个额外的传感器来评价SpotDiff, 上面标注了上标、SWIMS、相似性阈值和文字提示, 建立了强大的无训练基线。

blocks.en: We present SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for zero-shot remote sensing change detection that composes a self-supervised encoder, a universal feature upsampler and a promptable segmentation model. To our knowledge, it is the first change detection method to use a universal feature upsampler, and we show that pixel-resolution features are the single most important ingredient after multi-scale proposals.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍SpotDiff,一个零镜头遥感变化探测的无培训、插件和播放框架,它构成一个自我监督的编码器,一个通用的特征上标和快速分解模型。 据我们所知,这是第一个使用通用特性升温仪的变换检测方法,我们显示,像素分辨率特性是多尺度建议之后最重要的单一成分。

blocks.en: We show that comparing pixel-resolution self-supervised features inside text-guided region priors localizes change accurately without task-specific optimization, and we introduce SWIMS, a multi-scale inference strategy that makes the region priors reliable for small objects.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,比较文本制导区域内部的像素分辨率自我监督的特性,在不针对特定任务进行优化的情况下精确地本地化变化,我们引入了SWIMS,这是一种多尺度的推论策略,使区域对小对象的预测可靠.

blocks.en: We evaluate SpotDiff on four public benchmarks and two additional sensors, with ablations of the upsampler, SWIMS, the similarity threshold and the text prompt, establishing a strong training-free baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们用四个公共基准和两个额外的传感器来评价SpotDiff, 上面标注了上标、SWIMS、相似性阈值和文字提示, 建立了强大的无训练基线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early deep methods adapted encoder-decoder networks to bi-temporal inputs; FC-EF, FC-Siam-conc and FC-Siam-diff [ 10 ] introduced siamese fusion variants.
Later work added spatial-temporal attention (STANet [ 6 ] ), dense connections with deep supervision (SNUNet [ 17 ] ), transformers (BIT [ 7 ] , ChangeFormer [ 1 ] ), lightweight designs (TinyCD [ 9 ] ), state-space models (RS-Mamba [ 36 ] ) and adapted SAM encoders (SAM-CD [ 12 ] ).
ChangeCLIP [ 13 ] brings vision-language representations into supervised change detection.
These methods are accurate in-domain but require pixel-level annotations aligned across time.
blocks.zh:
早期的深层方法将编码器-解码器网络改造为双时输入;FC-EF,FC-Siam-conc和FC-Siam-diff[10]引入了暹罗聚变体.
后来的工作增加了时空注意(STANet [6]),与深层监理的密联(SNUNet [17]),变压器(BIT [7], ChangeFormer [1]),轻量级设计(TynyCD [9]),状态-空间模型(RS-Mamba [36])以及经过改造的SAM编码器(SAM-CD [12]).
ChangeCLIP [13] 将视觉语言的表示带入监督的变化检测中.
这些方法在域内是准确的,但需要像素级的注释在时间上一致.

blocks.en:
DINO [ 4 ] and DINOv2 [ 24 ] showed that self-supervised vision transformers learn transferable features; DINOv3 [ 29 ] scales this recipe and improves dense feature quality.
SAM [ 22 ] introduced promptable zero-shot segmentation, SAM 2 [ 26 ] extended it to video, and SAM 3 [ 3 ] segments all instances of a concept given a short noun phrase.
Remote sensing adaptations such as RSPrompter [ 8 ] and GeoSAM [ 20 ] fine-tune these models for specific tasks, which departs from the zero-shot setting.
blocks.zh:
DINO [4]和DINOv2 [24]显示,自控的视变器会学习可转移的特性;DINOv3 [29] 缩放这种配方,提高密集的特性质量.
SAM [22]引入了迅速的零射片段,SAM 2 [26]将其扩展为视频,SAM 3 [3] 将一个概念的所有实例都段给一个简短的名词短语.
遥感改造,如RSPrompter[8]和GeoSAM[20]对这些模型进行微调,以完成特定任务,这些模型偏离了零镜头设定.

blocks.en:
Classical unsupervised methods rely on change vector analysis, clustering or deep feature differencing [ 2 , 5 , 27 , 15 , 31 ] .
AnyChange [ 37 ] detects class-agnostic changes training-free by bitemporal latent matching in the SAM feature space, and SCM [ 30 ] combines SAM with CLIP for unsupervised building change.
BiSAM-CD [ 25 ] propagates masks with the temporal memory of SAM 2.
DynamicEarth [ 23 ] formalizes open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) and benchmarks training-free pipelines composed of mask proposers, comparators and identifiers.
OmniOVCD [ 35 ] streamlines OVCD with SAM 3 by fusing its semantic, instance and presence outputs and matching instances across dates. AdaptOVCD [ 14 ] fuses SAM-HQ masks, interpolated DINOv3 features and a remote sensing CLIP with adaptive thresholds, and OpenDPR [ 19 ] retrieves class prototypes from diffusion-synthesized support images and compares DINOv2 features.
SpotDiff shares the training-free, compositional spirit of these works, but decides change by comparing pixel-resolution self-supervised features rather than masks or SAM latents, and uses the segmentation model only to restrict where change is measured.
blocks.zh:
经典的无监督方法依赖于变化矢量分析,集群或深度特征差异[2,5,27,15,31].
AnyChange [37] 通过在 SAM 特性空间中进行咬定潜值匹配,检测班级不可知变化训练, SCM [30] 将 SAM 与 CLIP 合并,用于无监督的建筑变化.
BiSAM-CD [25] 传播带有SAM 2时间记忆的面具.
Dynamic Earth [23] 正式确定开放式伏尔加变化探测器(OVCD)和由面具提议者,参照者和识别器组成的无培训基准管道.
OmniOVCD [35] 将OVCD与SAM 3进行精简,将它的语义,实例和存在输出和跨日期匹配实例. 适应OVCD [14] 引信SAM-HQ口罩,内插的DINOv3特性和一个具有适应性阈值的遥感CLIP,OpenDPR [19] 从扩散-合成支持图像中回收类原型,并比较DINOv2特性.
SpotDiff分享了这些作品的无培训,组成精神,但通过比较像素分辨率自我监督的特性而不是面具或SAM潜质来决定改变,并且使用分割模型只是为了限制测量变化的地方.

blocks.en:
Vision transformers output features at patch resolution.
FeatUp [ 18 ] learns upsampling through multi-view consistency but must be trained per encoder.
AnyUp [ 33 ] is encoder-agnostic: trained once, it upsamples features from encoders it has never seen, which lets SpotDiff change its backbone without retraining anything. Change detection pipelines that compare foundation-model features have so far interpolated patch features to image resolution; to our knowledge, SpotDiff is the first to use a universal feature upsampler for change detection.
blocks.zh:
视觉变压器输出特性在补丁分辨率.
FeatUp [18] 通过多视图一致性学习提升样本,但必须每个编码器接受训练.
AnyUp [33] 是编码器-不可知论的:训练过一次,它从它从未见过的编码器上提升了样板特征,这使得SpotDiff可以改变它的骨干而无需再培训任何东西. 用于比较基础模型特性的改变检测管道到目前为止对图像分辨率具有插件特性;据我们所知,SpotDiff是第一个使用通用特性上标器进行改变检测的.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of SpotDiff. The Similarity Module encodes both images with a frozen vision foundation model, reconstructs pixel-resolution features with a universal upsampler and computes their per-pixel cosine similarity. The Region of Interest Proposal Module segments instances of the prompted category in each image with multi-scale inference (SWIMS) and fuses them across time. The Change Detection Module marks a candidate instance as changed when its mean similarity falls below a threshold. No component is trained.
blocks.zh: 图1: SpotDiff概览. 相似性模块将两种图像编码为冷冻的视觉基础模型,重建具有通用上标的像素分辨率特征,并计算出其每像素的宇宙相似性. 利益区域建议模块将每个图像中提示的类别实例分解为多尺度推论(SWIMS),并将它们贯穿于不同时期。 " 变化检测模块 " 表示一个候选实例,当其平均相似性低于阈值时即发生变化。 没有经过培训。

blocks.en:
SpotDiff separates what changed from where to look .
As shown in Fig. 1 , it has three components: a Similarity Module that measures semantic consistency across time at pixel resolution, a Region of Interest (RoI) Proposal Module that finds instances of the queried category, and a Change Detection Module that combines the two.
Every component is a frozen, off-the-shelf model or a parameter-free operation, so each can be replaced independently.
blocks.zh:
SpotDiff区分了从哪里看的变化.
如图1所示,它有三个组成部分:一个在像素解析时测量语义一致性的类似性模块,一个发现被询问类别实例的意向区域(RoI)建议模块,以及一个将两者结合起来的改变检测模块。
每个组件都是冷冻的,现成的模型或无参数操作,因此每个组件都可以独立替换.

blocks.en: 3.3 Region of Interest Proposal Module
blocks.zh: 3.3 利益区建议书单元

On large tiles, a single forward pass misses many small or partially visible instances.

We use 𝒦 = { 1 , 2 } \mathcal{K}=\{1,2\} : the 2 × 2\times scale recovers small objects, while adding 4 × 4\times introduces false positives from over-magnified, uniform regions ( Sec. 4.3 ).

A pair of instances from the two dates with IoU above 0.5 is treated as the same, persistent object and both are discarded; all other instances of either date are kept. Objects that appear, disappear or change footprint are therefore examined.

blocks.en: 3.4 Change Detection Module
blocks.zh: 3.4 变化检测模块

blocks.en:
Methods that decide change by mask overlap or instance correspondence propagate every segmentation error into the change map.
SpotDiff instead uses semantic consistency as the decision signal and the proposals only to define where it is evaluated.
For every candidate instance m ∈ 𝐌 m\in\mathbf{M} we compute its mean similarity s m = 1 | m | ​ ∑ ( i , j ) ∈ m S ⁡ ( i , j ) , s_{m}=\frac{1}{|m|}\sum_{(i,j)\in m}S(i,j), (7) where | m | |m| is the number of pixels in the instance, and declare the instance changed if s m < τ s_{m}<\tau .
The change mask is the union of all changed instances, 𝐘 = ⋁ m ∈ 𝐌 : s m < τ m , \mathbf{Y}=\bigvee_{m\in\mathbf{M}:\;s_{m}<\tau}m, (8) where ∨ \vee is the pixel-wise logical OR.
Averaging over an instance makes the decision robust to isolated noisy pixels in 𝐒 \mathbf{S} , and a semantic disagreement counts as change only when it is supported by an object proposal, which suppresses changes of other categories such as seasonal vegetation when detecting buildings.
We use a single threshold for all datasets ( τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 , Sec. 4.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.5 Plug-and-play design
blocks.zh: 3.5 插件和游戏设计

blocks.en:
The Similarity Module is the composition 𝒮 = cos ∘ ( g ϕ ∘ f θ ) \mathcal{S}=\mathrm{cos}\circ(g_{\phi}\circ f_{\theta}) , the RoI module is any promptable segmenter, and the Change Detection Module depends on neither.
A stronger encoder, upsampler or segmenter can therefore be substituted without modifying or retraining the rest of the pipeline.
In this paper, swapping the DINOv3 backbone from ViT-L to ViT-7B requires no change other than the checkpoint.

因此,可以在不修改或再培训管道其余部分的情况下替换一个更强大的编码器、上标或分解器。
在本报中,将DINov3主干线从VIT-L换成VIT-7B,只需检查点即可更改.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
LEVIR-CD [ 6 ] contains 637 pairs of 1024 × \times 1024 images at 0.5 m from 20 regions in Texas, with building construction and demolition over 5–14 years; we use the standard test split. WHU-CD [ 21 ] covers building change over a 20.5 km 2 urban area in aerial imagery; as the 256 × 256 256\times 256 patch split of [ 35 ] is not public, we evaluate on 154 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 test tiles, so WHU-CD numbers are not strictly comparable with the baselines. S2Looking [ 28 ] contains 5,000 pairs from several satellites with side-looking (off-nadir) views of rural building change. SECOND [ 34 ] contains 4,662 semantic change pairs of 512 × \times 512 pixels with six land-cover classes; following [ 23 , 35 ] , each class is evaluated as binary change on the 1,694-pair test split.
For qualitative cross-resolution results we use PlanetScope imagery at 3 m from DynamicEarthNet [ 32 ] and Sentinel-2 RGB imagery at 10 m from OSCD [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
LEVIR-CD [6] 包含637对1024×\times 1024图像,距离德克萨斯州20个地区0.5米,建筑施工和拆除时间为5~14年;我们采用标准测试分数. WHU-CD [21] 覆盖了空中图像20.5 km 2 城区的建筑变化;由于256 × 256\times 256的补丁拆分[35]是不公开的,我们评价154 1024× 1024\times 1024测试瓷砖,因此WHU-CD数字与基线没有严格的可比性. S2Looking [28] 包含数颗卫星的5000对,对农村建筑变化具有侧视(off-nadir)视角. 第二 [34] 包含4,662个语义变换对512×\time 512像素,有6个土地覆盖类;在[23,35]之后,每类在1,694-pair测试拆分上被评价为二进制变换.
对于质的跨分辨率结果,我们使用距离动态地球网3米的PlanetScope图像[32]和距离OSCD[11]10米的Sentinel-2 RGB图像。

blocks.en: We report IoU, F1, precision and recall of the change class, in %, with F1 as the primary metric.
blocks.zh: 我们报告IoU, F1, 精确和召回变化等级, 以%, F1作为主要衡量标准。

blocks.en:
We compare with unsupervised methods [ 5 , 16 , 15 , 27 , 31 , 2 ] , the training-free AnyChange [ 37 ] and SCM [ 30 ] , the strongest DynamicEarth pipelines [ 23 ] , OmniOVCD [ 35 ] , AdaptOVCD [ 14 ] and OpenDPR [ 19 ] .
This work was carried out in March 2026, so we compare with training-free methods published before April 2026; later work is not included. Baseline numbers are taken from [ 35 ] , which re-implements the DynamicEarth pipelines under identical settings; AdaptOVCD and OpenDPR numbers are taken from their papers.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了无监督方法[5,16,15,27,31,2],无训练的AnyChange[37]和SCM[30],最强的动态地球管道[23],OmniOVCD[35],AdaptOVCD[14]和OpenDPR[19].
这项工作于2026年3月进行,因此我们比较了2026年4月前公布的无培训方法;后来的工作不包括在内. 基线数字取自[35],该数字在相同的环境下重新实施动态地球管道; 适应OVCD和OpenDPR数字取自他们的论文。

blocks.en:
We use DINOv3 [ 29 ] ViT-7B/16 (default) or ViT-L/16 (300M parameters) as the encoder, the released AnyUp [ 33 ] model as the upsampler, and SAM 3 [ 3 ] with text prompts for region proposals.
Unless noted, SWIMS uses scales { 1 × , 2 × } \{1\times,2\times\} , τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 , and building change is prompted with “roof”, the best prompt in Tab. 6 . On SECOND, each class is prompted with one or more class names and the instances of all its prompts are pooled: building (“building”), tree (“tree”, “forest”), water (“water”, “river”, “pond”, “sea”), low vegetation (“low vegetation”, “grass”), surface (“the ground”, “bare land”) and playground (“football court”, “basketball court”, “baseball court”). An instance is discarded if more than half of it is covered by negative prompts (“background”; for surface also the other classes, “cropland” and “sports field”; for playground also “building” and “blue roof”), and the covered pixels are removed otherwise.
No training is performed; all experiments run on a single NVIDIA H100 (80 GB) or H200 (141 GB) GPU.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Tab. 2 compares SpotDiff with unsupervised and training-free methods.
On LEVIR-CD, SpotDiff with ViT-7B reaches 82.46 F1 and 70.15 IoU, 2.06 F1 and 2.95 IoU above OmniOVCD and 14.46 F1 above AdaptOVCD, with 74.70 precision and 92.00 recall.
With the smaller ViT-L encoder (300M parameters) it reaches 80.10 F1, on par with OmniOVCD.
For reference, fully supervised methods trained on the LEVIR-CD training set reach about 90 F1 [ 12 , 9 ] , so SpotDiff closes most of the gap without a single labelled pair.
On WHU-CD and S2Looking, SpotDiff reaches 86.47 and 44.55 F1 with ViT-7B, compared with 79.9 and 39.4 for OmniOVCD (WHU-CD on a different test tiling, see Sec. 4 ). With ViT-L, it reaches 86.06 F1 on WHU-CD but trails OmniOVCD on S2Looking (33.87 F1), where the off-nadir views benefit most from the larger encoder.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 2将SpotDiff与无监督及无训练方法进行比较.
在LEVIR-CD上,配有ViT-7B的SpotDiff达到82.46 F1和70.15 IoU,比OmniOVCD高2.06 F1和2.95 IoU,比AditOVCD高14.46 F1,精度74.70和92.00召回.
以较小的VIT-L编码器(300M参数),它与OmniOVCD等价达到80.10 F1.
作为参考,在LEVIR-CD训练集中训练的完全监督的方法达到大约90 F1 [12,9],因此SpotDiff没有单对标签就关闭了大部分差距.
在WHU-CD和S2Looking上,SpotDiff与ViT-7B一起达到86.47和44.55 F1,而OmniOVCD则达到79.9和39.4(WHU-CD在不同的测试板上,见Sec.4 )。 它与Vit-L一起在WHU-CD上达到了86.06 F1,但在S2Looking(33.87 F1)上追踪了OmniOVCD,其中非纳迪尔观点从更大的编码器中获益最大.

blocks.en:
Tab. 3 reports per-class results on SECOND.
SpotDiff improves over OmniOVCD on building (+10.3 IoU), water (+6.4), low vegetation (+4.2) and playground (+0.6), and is slightly lower on tree ( − - 0.5) and surface ( − - 4.5). Against AdaptOVCD and OpenDPR, it is best on building, water and low vegetation, while OpenDPR is stronger on tree and playground and AdaptOVCD on surface.
The gains concentrate on classes with clear object structure, which is where instance-level comparison of semantic features helps most; amorphous classes such as impervious surface are harder to delineate as instances, which limits the region prior.
Averaged over all six classes, SpotDiff reaches 29.34 IoU and 44.23 F1, against 27.1 and 41.8 for OmniOVCD, 28.05 and 42.74 for AdaptOVCD, and 28.6 and 43.7 for OpenDPR. Fig. 3 shows selected test pairs covering all six classes. SpotDiff recovers new playgrounds, buildings and vegetation patches with object-aligned boundaries, while OmniOVCD often marks large unchanged areas as changed surface (#09319, #05623, #07898). Errors remain on mixed scenes: in #02493 part of a rebuilt roof is labelled low vegetation, and small tree changes are partly missed.

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 compares SpotDiff with OmniOVCD on LEVIR-CD.
OmniOVCD produces false alarms along roads and on bare ground and misses several small buildings, while SpotDiff keeps its predictions on changed buildings.
The similarity maps show why: unchanged roofs and roads stay highly similar across dates, while new buildings appear as compact low-similarity regions.
blocks.zh:
图2 将SpotDiff与LEVIR-CD上的OmniOVCD进行比较.
OmniOVCD沿着道路和赤裸裸的地面产生假警报,并错过几座小建筑,而SpotDiff则对已改变的建筑保持预测.
相似性图显示了为什么:不同日期的屋顶和道路保持高度相似,而新建筑则显示为紧凑的低相似性区域。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Cross-resolution results of the class-agnostic variant ( τ = 0.7 \tau=0.7 ) on medium-resolution imagery, using the same models and settings as on sub-meter data. Magenta: pixels with cosine similarity below τ \tau (changed). (a) PlanetScope at 3 m: deforestation, urban and port changes. (b) Sentinel-2 RGB at 10 m: building, road and land-clearing changes.
blocks.zh: 图4:使用与子米数据相同的模型和设置,在中分辨率图像上的类不可知变体(\\ tau=0.7)的交叉分辨率结果. 紫红色:在\ tau 下有余弦相似的像素( 已更改) 。 (a) 3米处的行星范围:毁林、城市和港口变化。 (b) 哨兵-2RGB,10米:建筑、道路和清除土地的改变。

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 applies the same pipeline, unchanged, to PlanetScope (3 m) and Sentinel-2 (10 m) imagery.
Deforestation, urban growth, new roads and land clearing appear as coherent low-similarity regions, and the change maps follow their boundaries despite the coarser ground sampling distance.
At 10 m, isolated buildings span only a few pixels and are detected as small blobs, which marks the practical lower limit of the approach.
These results are qualitative, as neither dataset provides category-specific labels matching our prompts.
blocks.zh:
图4对PlanetScope(3米)和Sentinel-2(10米)图像采用了相同的管道,没有改变。
森林砍伐、城市增长、新道路和土地清理看来是连贯的低等区域,尽管地面采样距离较窄,但变化图仍按其边界排列。
在10米处,孤立的建筑仅跨过几个像素,被检测为小块,这标志着方法的实际下限.
这些结果都是定性的,因为两个数据集都没有提供与我们的提示相匹配的特定类别标签.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4: Upsampler ablation on LEVIR-CD (%).
blocks.zh: 表4:LEVIR-CD的 Upsampler消毒率(%)。

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 replaces AnyUp with nearest-neighbor or bilinear interpolation of the DINOv3 features.
AnyUp gives the highest F1 and precision, 13.8 F1 above the bilinear interpolation used by prior feature-comparison pipelines [ 14 ] : interpolation blurs features across object boundaries, so the similarity of small buildings is mixed with that of their surroundings, whereas image-guided upsampling keeps boundaries sharp.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 4 将 AnyUp 替换为 DINov3 特性的近邻或双线插值。
AnyUp给出了最高的F1和精度,比先前的特征比较管道所使用的双线插值高13.8 F1:插值模糊了跨越对象边界的特征,因此小建筑的相似性与周围的相似性混合,而图像制导的上标保持了尖锐的边界.

blocks.en: Table 5: SWIMS scales and threshold τ \tau on LEVIR-CD (F1, %). Columns are values of τ \tau .
blocks.zh: 表5:LEVIR-CD上的SWIMS尺度和阈值(F1%)。 列是\ tau 的值。

blocks.en:
Tab. 5 varies the SWIMS scales and τ \tau for both encoders.
Adding the 2 × 2\times scale is the single largest effect in the pipeline: +21.4 F1 for ViT-7B (61.09 to 82.46 at τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 ) and +21.3 for ViT-L (59.95 to 81.29 at τ = 0.7 \tau=0.7 ).
Adding 4 × 4\times lowers F1 for both encoders, because over-magnified windows contain uniform texture that SAM 3 segments into spurious instances.
With { 1 × , 2 × } \{1\times,2\times\} , F1 stays within 0.4 of its maximum over τ ∈ [ 0.6 , 0.65 ] \tau\in[0.6,0.65] for ViT-7B and [ 0.65 , 0.7 ] [0.65,0.7] for ViT-L, so the method is not sensitive to the exact threshold.
Figure 5 : SWIMS vs. single-scale inference on LEVIR-CD. SAM 3 instances at 1 × 1\times (top) and with SWIMS { 1 × , 2 × } \{1\times,2\times\} (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图5: SWIMS对LEVIR-CD的单级推论. SAM 3例在1×1\时(上),与 SWIMS {1×,2×}\1\时,2×(下).

blocks.en: Fig. 5 illustrates the effect: at a single scale SAM 3 misses most small residential buildings in a 1024 × \times 1024 tile, and the 2 × 2\times windows recover them.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Sensitivity on LEVIR-CD. (a) F1 against the similarity threshold τ \tau for each SWIMS scale setting and encoder ( Tab. 5 ). (b) F1 for four synonymous SAM 3 prompts ( Tab. 6 ).
blocks.zh: 图6:对LEVIR-CD的敏感性。 (a) F1与每个SWIMS比例尺设置和编码器的相似性阈值\\ tau(表5)。 (b) F1用于四个同义词SAM 3 提示(Tab. 6 )。

blocks.en: Fig. 6 (a) shows the same trends: the 2 × 2\times scale lifts every curve, and all curves peak in τ ∈ [ 0.6 , 0.7 ] \tau\in[0.6,0.7] , so a single fixed threshold works for both encoders.
blocks.zh: 图6(a)显示相同趋势:2×2\时标抬起每个曲线,所有曲线的峰值在\\\\\\[0.6,0.7]\tau\ in[0.6,0.7]中,因此两个编码器都有一个固定的阈值工作.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Text-prompt sensitivity on LEVIR-CD (%, SWIMS { 1 × , 2 × } \{1\times,2\times\} , τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 ).

Tab. 6 and Fig. 6 (b) vary the SAM 3 prompt for building change.
“Roof” is best for both encoders, 5.3 (ViT-7B) and 5.1 (ViT-L) F1 above “building”, likely because roofs are what a building looks like from above.
Across the four synonymous prompts F1 varies by up to 5.9 points, so the prompt is a meaningful, training-free knob, and also a source of variance that users of text-prompted change detection should be aware of.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 6和图 6(b) 更改SAM 3换楼的提示。
“屋顶”对编码器来说都是最好的,在“建筑”上方是5.3(ViT-7B)和5.1(ViT-L)F1, 这可能是因为屋顶是建筑物从上面看起来的样子。
在整个四个同义词中,提示F1的分数各有不同,最高可达5.9分,因此提示是一个有意义的,没有训练的knob,也是文本提示变化检测器的用户应该意识到的差异源.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for zero-shot remote sensing change detection.
It composes a self-supervised encoder, a universal feature upsampler and a promptable segmentation model, and decides change by comparing pixel-resolution features inside text-guided region priors made reliable by multi-scale inference.
Without change labels or fine-tuning, SpotDiff reaches 82.46 F1 on LEVIR-CD, improves building change detection on SECOND by 10.3 IoU over the strongest prior training-free method, and transfers to 3 m and 10 m imagery unchanged.
Because every component is replaceable, SpotDiff should improve as foundation models do.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了SpotDiff, 一个零镜头遥感变化探测的无培训、插件和游戏框架。
它由自我监督的编码器,通用的特征提升标码器和可快速分解模型组成,并通过比较文本引导区域内部的像素分辨率特性来决定变化,这些特性通过多尺度推论而变得可靠.
在没有改变标签或微调的情况下,SpotDiff在LEVIR-CD上达到82.46 F1,在LEVIR-CD上改进了10.3 IoU对前期最强无训练方法的建置变化检测,并转至3米和10米图像不变.
由于每个组件都可以替换,SpotDiff应该像基础模型那样改进.

blocks.en:
The similarity threshold is fixed; adaptive thresholding from image statistics could improve robustness.
The method assumes co-registered images, inference is dominated by multi-scale SAM 3 and, with ViT-7B, by the encoder, and accuracy depends on the text prompt ( Tab. 6 ).
Region priors help most for object-like categories and less for amorphous ones such as impervious surface.
SpotDiff is evaluated on RGB optical imagery only; multispectral and SAR inputs are left to future work.
blocks.zh:
相似性阈值是固定的;根据图像统计进行适应性阈值可提高稳健性。
该方法假设共同注册的图像,推论以多级SAM 3为主,与ViT-7B为编码器,准确性取决于文本的提示(Tab. 6).
区域前缀对对象类帮助最大,对非形态类如不透水面类帮助较少.
SpotDiff只在RGB光学图像上评价;多光谱和合成孔径雷达投入留待未来工作处理。
